### Giselle's Emphasis on Passing Drills

Giselle is keen on honing her passing skills, which she proposes to do by incorporating cones into the practice drills. She suggests a specific emphasis on short passing patterns during their session. Her proactive approach in seeking out additional practice materials (cones) and structuring the session around this goal reflects a strategic interest in refining a fundamental aspect of her game. Giselle's participation in the practice indicates an acknowledgment of the importance of passing as a vital component of soccer, recognizing that through targeted drills, she can achieve substantial improvement in this area.
